purpose: A curated knowledge base for contributing to the TYPO3 core: the contribution rules, the Gerrit workflow, script and test invocation, architecture conventions per subsystem, and a catalog of the registered backend UI components.
instructions: A conventions catalog for TYPO3 core contributions, not a patch assistant. Every answer comes from this server's own bundled knowledge; it never reads, inspects, or runs anything against a TYPO3 core checkout and cannot be pointed at one. It therefore does not know your branch, your changed files, which tests cover them, or whether a path or identifier still exists on your branch — discover that in the checkout yourself, then bring the concrete paths back to typo3_architecture_lookup and typo3_task_guide. Call typo3_server_scope for what is covered, at which depth, and which tool answers what.

covers.depth: Curated prose. The rules a patch is judged by, not a full style guide.

covers.topic: Gerrit workflow: setup, pushing, amending, backports
covers.depth: Curated prose, command level. Covers the local git side; it cannot talk to the Gerrit server.
Rules plus a working draft and check, including 72-character body wrapping.

covers.topic: runTests.sh suites, options, and targeted invocation
covers.depth: Every suite this knowledge base knows, with the command, the targeted form, and when to use it.

covers.topic: Core architecture conventions: DI, events and hooks, TCA and FormEngine, FormEngine data providers, DataHandler, routing, Fluid templates and ViewHelpers, TypoScript site sets and TSconfig, language files, testing strategy
covers.depth: Conventions per subsystem, matched by path or topic. It describes how the core is built, never what your checkout contains.

covers.topic: Backend CSS architecture, design tokens, class naming
covers.depth: Curated prose covering the Sass sources, the token contract, and the component structure.

covers.topic: Backend UI components: markup, variants, custom properties
covers.depth: Hand-curated subset of the backend components, not every CSS class in the core.

covers.topic: Translation domains: how the domain of an XLF file is derived
covers.depth: Complete and computed, not a snapshot: the rules of TranslationDomainResolver ported here, so any XLF path in any extension resolves — including a file that does not exist yet.
The core revision, branch, and verification date behind every catalog answer.

doesNotCover.topic: Your checkout: changed files, branch, working tree, local git state
doesNotCover.why: This server answers from its own bundled knowledge and never reads, inspects, or runs anything against a TYPO3 core checkout. It cannot be pointed at one.
doesNotCover.instead: Determine the changed paths yourself (git status, git diff --name-only), then pass them to typo3_architecture_lookup and typo3_task_guide to get the conventions and checks that apply to them.

doesNotCover.topic: The core source itself: API signatures, TCA of a table, existing implementations
doesNotCover.why: The knowledge base describes conventions, not code. No core sources ship with it.
doesNotCover.instead: Read the checkout. Use this server for how the subsystem is built and what a patch has to satisfy.

doesNotCover.topic: Which test covers a given file
doesNotCover.why: Test coverage is a property of the checkout, and no index of it is bundled.
doesNotCover.instead: Core tests mirror the class path below typo3/sysext/<ext>/Tests/Unit/ and Tests/Functional/, so typo3/sysext/core/Classes/DataHandling/DataHandler.php is covered by typo3/sysext/core/Tests/Unit/DataHandling/DataHandlerTest.php. Look the file up there, then ask typo3_test_run_guide for the targeted runTests.sh invocation.

doesNotCover.topic: Whether a component or CSS class still exists on your branch
doesNotCover.why: The component catalog is a snapshot of one pinned core revision; a miss means "not in this snapshot", never "does not exist".
doesNotCover.instead: Call typo3_catalog_scope for the revision behind it, and verify against the checkout when you work on a different branch.

doesNotCover.topic: Gerrit server state: review status, patch sets, votes, CI results
doesNotCover.why: The server talks to nothing over the network.
doesNotCover.instead: Use the Gerrit web UI or git. The local side of the workflow — pushing, amending, backporting — is covered by typo3://core/typo3-gerrit-workflow.

doesNotCover.topic: Work outside TYPO3 core contribution: site setup, project or third-party extension development, configuring an installation with TypoScript, upgrading an installation
doesNotCover.why: The knowledge base is scoped to contributing to the core. Shipping TypoScript defaults from a system extension is core work and is covered; writing TypoScript to configure a site is not, and neither is a package under packages/ or an extension outside typo3/sysext/.
doesNotCover.instead: Use the TYPO3 documentation at https://docs.typo3.org/.

doesNotCover.why: IconRegistry is assembled at runtime from every installed package, so the registered identifiers are a property of the instance, not of TYPO3. This server does not know which packages you have installed and cannot ship a list that is right for you.
doesNotCover.instead: Resolve the identifier in your own checkout: the T3Icons set in typo3/sysext/core/Resources/Public/Icons/T3Icons/icons.json, the Configuration/Icons.php of every package, and the flag images under typo3/sysext/core/Resources/Public/Icons/Flags/. typo3_architecture_lookup has how to render one once you have it.

doesNotCover.topic: Which labels exist, and what an XLF file contains
doesNotCover.why: Labels are a property of the instance: every installed extension ships its own, and an installation can override any language file through LANG/resourceOverrides. This server does not read a checkout and cannot ship a list that is right for yours.
doesNotCover.instead: Search the XLF files of your own checkout for an existing label before inventing a key. typo3_translation_domain_lookup gives you the domain to reference it by once you have found it.

checkoutDiscovery.establish: Which files the task actually touches
checkoutDiscovery.how: git status --short and git diff --name-only in the core checkout, then call typo3_architecture_lookup with those paths for the conventions that apply to them.
Core tests mirror the class path below typo3/sysext/<ext>/Tests/Unit/ and Tests/Functional/. Find the file there, then ask typo3_test_run_guide for the targeted runTests.sh invocation.

checkoutDiscovery.establish: The branch you are on and the branches the change is meant for
checkoutDiscovery.how: git branch --show-current. In the normal case the patch targets main and the merging core team member handles the backport; push to a release branch only when the bug does not exist on main.

checkoutDiscovery.establish: Whether the paths, classes, labels, and identifiers named in an answer still exist on that branch
checkoutDiscovery.how: Grep the checkout. The catalogs are a snapshot of one revision — typo3_catalog_scope names it.

checkoutDiscovery.establish: Whether an icon identifier is registered, and which one spells the shape you want
checkoutDiscovery.how: Identifiers are <family>-<name> and spell shapes, not intents. Search typo3/sysext/core/Resources/Public/Icons/T3Icons/icons.json for the T3Icons set, grep typo3/sysext/*/Configuration/Icons.php and the same file in any other installed package for extension-registered ones, and list typo3/sysext/core/Resources/Public/Icons/Flags/ for the flags-* family.

checkoutDiscovery.establish: Whether a label for this wording already exists
checkoutDiscovery.how: Grep the English source texts and trans-unit ids in typo3/sysext/*/Resources/Private/Language/*.xlf, and in the same path of any other installed extension. A file may be overridden per installation through LANG/resourceOverrides, so the instance decides what is actually resolved.

routing.when: Starting a core task and looking for the applicable conventions and checks
About to write backend markup or invent a CSS class name
About to run tests or any other core check
Working in a concrete file and unsure about the subsystem's conventions
Writing or amending the commit message
Pushing for review, amending a patch set, or backporting
A catalog lookup found nothing that should exist
Needing the translation domain an XLF file resolves to
